clips.title: The story
paras: Sacred water is brought to bear on the red crystal in Darkshore. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea hopes moonwell water from Auberdine will reveal what lies beneath its opaque surface.

Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea seeks a safe way to study the red crystal high on Darkshore's eastern cliffs. Moonwell water holds divine, restorative magic, blessed by the night elves' devotion to Elune. Glynda believes water from Auberdine's moonwell may react with the strange stone and pierce its opaque shell without destroying it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Use this empty vial and fill up on some moonwell water here in Auberdine. Such potent magic should provide a clue as to the composition of the crystal. To do that, you'll pour the liquid over the crystal; it should take care of the rest.

While I don't anticipate anything bad happening to you, I still want you to be careful. Above us to the east is Felwood; if that crystal is tied to that place as I suspect it is, then it could prove to be very dangerous.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore. You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have made it once more to the mysterious crystal. Removing the stopper on the tube of moonwell water, you gingerly pour the contents out over the top of the crystal. As the water cascades down its lattices, you see the opaque surface turn transparent...
